clinical_intent: I need to create a protocol for the management of brachytherapy in pregnant patients. Given the rarity of this scenario, the protocol should cover: (1) eligibility criteria for brachytherapy during pregnancy, (2) radiation safety considerations for the fetus, (3) modified treatment planning approaches, (4) concurrent chemotherapy modifications, (5) delivery planning and timing, (6) neonatal follow-up requirements, and (7) documentation and ethics committee requirements. Please provide this rare-scenario protocol.
